title: Ezei
tagline: Atomic swap based on SEI blockchain. Swap between SEI and EVM chains
description: Atomic swap based on Fusion+ protocol with SEI to EVM chains swap. So Fusion+ is integrated with Sei. As Sei is a high performing chain which is EVM compatible. And we will add more chains to the ecosystem later on. The project solely aims to do swaps, rebalancing protfolio, memecoin trades and etc. And can also be done by agent.
how_its_made: This project uses Next.js for the frontend. And 1inch APIs. And backend stack is express. And solidity for smart contarct. And contracts to be deployed at testnet. The project showcases the use of 1inch APIs and their Overpowered Protocol Fusion+. I have integrated Fusion+ with Sei chain, which is a high performing EVM compatible chain.
